findings.evidence: Lines 124-197 define 15 linearity lemmas for the three components; lines 210-228 (`ofLightFront` plus only `_def` and four `_inl`/`_inr_*` apply lemmas) and lines 321-341 plus 460-466, 552-556 (`relativeTransverse` and its lemmas) contain no `_add`/`_smul`/`_zero` statement, and no `→ₗ`/`≃ₗ` bundling of the components exists anywhere in the file.
findings.fix: Expose the universal property as a bundled equivalence, e.g. `lightFrontEquiv : Lorentz.Vector 3 ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)` (or three `Lorentz.Vector 3 →ₗ[ℝ] _` maps), derive the existing component lemmas from it, and add the missing `ofLightFront_add`/`_smul`/`_zero` and `relativeTransverse_add`/`_smul` (linear in `k` for fixed `P`).
findings.issue: `ofLightFront` (line 210) and `relativeTransverse` (line 321) are listed as main definitions but have no interaction with the operations the file otherwise develops in full: `plusComponent`/`minusComponent`/`transversePart` each get `_add`, `_smul`, `_zero`, `_neg`, `_sub` (lines 124-197), while `ofLightFront` and `relativeTransverse` get none. Nothing is bundled either, so a consumer cannot get `plusComponent (∑ i, p i) = ∑ i, plusComponent (p i)` from this API at all — the twelve unbundled lemmas do not yield `map_sum` without a manual `Finset` induction.

findings.evidence: Lines 476 and 487-489 rewrite only with `relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` / `relativeTransverse_of_plusComponent_eq_zero`; lines 565-566 and 576-577 use `Orientation.areaForm_comp_linearIsometryEquiv _ R hR`, which in mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/TwoDim.lean:157 is stated for the section variable `o : Orientation ℝ E (Fin 2)`, i.e. an arbitrary orientation.
findings.fix: Take `(o : Orientation ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (Fin 2))` as a parameter in all four and state them as `o.areaForm ... = o.areaForm ...`; the proofs are unchanged.
findings.issue: `areaForm_relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` (470), `areaForm_transversePart_relativeTransverse_transverseBoost` (480), `areaForm_transversePart_relativeTransverse_transverseIsometry` (560) and `areaForm_relativeTransverse_transverseIsometry` (570) are stated only for `(orientation (Fin 2))`, but none of their proofs uses anything about the standard orientation, so consumers working with another orientation of the plane (e.g. `-orientation (Fin 2)`, which the §0.4 parity statement will reach via reflection of `kT`) cannot apply them.

summary: Two of the five advertised main definitions, `ofLightFront` and `relativeTransverse`, ship with no interaction lemmas for the linear operations the rest of the file develops exhaustively, and nothing is bundled, so `map_sum` and friends are unreachable. The four `areaForm_*` invariance lemmas are also pinned to `EuclideanSpace.orientation` although their proofs never use it.
